originality.rationale: An earlier calculation completely covers d=3, including its Segre P2xP2 singular stratum and rank-one 2x4 cone, so no novelty is asserted for that case. The new single claim is the complete theorem for every d>=3, with exact formal local rank-one 2-by-(d-1)^2 determinantal equations, no other singular components, and unbounded multiplicity (d-1)^2. This is strictly stronger in quantified domain: the previously known instance alone does not imply the all-rank theorem. The October 2026 primary paper establishes the truncated family, not these all-size singularity claims. Historical priority beyond the inspected sources remains qualified.

value.rationale: A finite d=3 singularity computation already exists and is not the claimed novelty. The new result is the complete uniform classification of every balanced next-to-full truncated Grassmannian in dimensions d>=3, giving an unbounded family with exactly one reduced Segre stratum and an explicit quadratic multiplicity law. This is stronger mathematically than incrementing a dimension or recomputing an isolated example: it establishes an all-d structural statement whose large-dimensional singularity types vary, relevant for further birational and intersection-theoretic questions. It does not purport to be a classification of unrelated Grassmannian projections.
